toc.title: Amplissimo et clarissimo viro Dn. Nicolao Dobbino, I.V. Doctori praestantissimo, Electoralis Palatinatus Consiliario
Oratio de praecipuis laudibus et utilitatibus Philosophiæ politicæ.

book: A single printed oration (Heidelberg, 1590) by Kahl on the praises and uses of political philosophy, preceded by a dedicatory address to Nicolaus Dobbinus; the title page and running heads are not divisions, and the oration has no numbered internal divisions.
